SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season IN (2, 6)
  AND cls IN ('day_1_5', 'three_quarter')
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 14 AND 120
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 200;
